answer: The kernel counter is kept in haven and sonnet shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 37 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
